snippet.title: Pillars of Pantheon - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A roguelite where you build and pilot a war machine and fight massive waves of enemies.

WISHLIST PILLARS OF PANTHEON NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4349540/Pillars_of_Pantheon

Discord:
https://discord.gg/zdJ5D5uU9r

Pillars of Pantheon is a fast-paced mythological horde-survival roguelite. Build and customize your pillar by stacking marble blocks, ballistae, spears, shields, and mythical artifacts. Charge straight into overwhelming enemy hordes. Gain the favor of the Roman gods to unlock devastating abilities, summon allied minions, and reshape your pillar into a moving engine of war.

Explore maps inspired by real Mediterranean locations, defeat iconic bosses, and face unforgiving challenges with your friends in co-op or die alone. Experiment with synergies, divine powers, and architectural creativity to survive the horrors of the underworld. 

Stand tall. Build with style. Or be reduced to rubble.

Music: Dragon Castle by Makai Symphony 
https://soundcloud.com/makai-symphony/dragon-castle
